QuestionStmt.S: Identify the geometry of $\mathrm{TeF_4}$ molecule from the following.

Solution.S: Tellurium (Te) belongs to group 16 and has 6 valence electrons. In TeF₄, Te forms 4 sigma bonds with fluorine atoms, using 4 of its valence electrons. The remaining 2 electrons constitute one lone pair. Thus the molecule has 4 bonding pairs and 1 lone pair (AB₄E type). According to VSEPR theory, this electron geometry is trigonal bipyramidal, and the molecular geometry is see-saw. Therefore, the correct option is C: Trigonal bipyramidal.
